title: Show a standing blocking evaluation before a host spawns an evaluator, and give the re-roll refusal a typed class
outcome: Show a standing blocking evaluation before a host spawns an evaluator, and give the re-roll refusal a typed class
acceptance: Before this item completes, its holder note retains TermAl-owner evidence for the consuming host: a standing typed reroll refuses termal_evaluate_acceptance before any evaluator child or delegation is created (both counts unchanged); a non-refusing status permits spawn; a pinned live check names the real Engram producer/build. Engram show/next and CLI/MCP typed refusals plus a race case are tested and documented; a permissive reroll result means only this guard permits, with other admission conditions still enforced.
